data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 提出并训练可复用的 idea 级 critic 作为环内验证器，以预测准确率反馈改进，并用于后续推理演化与策略训练。

scope_support.feedback_quote: We train the critic models through supervised fine-tuning on high-quality critiques synthesized by Gemini-3.1-Pro, followed by GRPO to further improve their predictive accuracy.
scope_support.object_quote: specialized idea-level critic models that predict whether a proposed ML modification will improve upon the current solution
scope_support.persistence_quote: During inference-time evolution, they improve final solution quality under the same verification budget by selecting more promising ideas, with further gains from continual learning.
